name: checkpoint kinase 1
pathways: signal transduction in response to DNA damage

function.text: CHEK1 encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase Chk1. Annotated molecular activities include protein kinase activity and histone H3T11 kinase activity. It participates in DNA repair and signal transduction in response to DNA damage.
